body:
Self-contained specification for `bin/hook-runner.sh` `PASSWD_HOME` audit-log anchoring and fallback read-only updates:

1. `bin/hook-runner.sh`:
   - In `emit_fallback` (`IS_READ_ONLY` `case "$TOOL_NAME"` around line 204): add `list_dir|list_permissions|search_in_file|wait|wait_5_seconds` to the read-only tool list, and change `manage_task` in that fallback list so `manage_task` only sets `IS_READ_ONLY=1` when `TMP_FLAT` does NOT match `"kill"` or `"send_input"`.
   - Implement `PASSWD_HOME` audit-log anchoring at the top of `bin/hook-runner.sh` (replacing lines 14–20):
     1. Compute `RUNNER_DIR="$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)"` and `RUNNER_ROOT="$(dirname -- "$RUNNER_DIR")"` upfront (reuse for `LAUNCHER_DIR`/`PLUGIN_ROOT`).
     2. Resolve OS account home `PASSWD_HOME="$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"` (with macOS fallback `if [ -z "$PASSWD_HOME" ] && command -v dscl >/dev/null 2>&1; then PASSWD_HOME="$(dscl . -read "/Users/$(id -un)" NFSHomeDirectory 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')"; fi`).
     3. Staging check: in `case "$RUNNER_ROOT" in */.gemini/config/plugins/*)` **unconditionally ignore `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` and `HOME`** for log resolution (using `PASSWD_HOME`, falling back to `${RUNNER_ROOT%%/.gemini/*}` verified via `[ -O ... ]` only if `PASSWD_HOME` is empty). Only when `RUNNER_ROOT` is outside `*/.gemini/config/plugins/*` AND `[ -f "$RUNNER_ROOT/test/hook-runner.test.mjs" ]` may non-empty `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` override `PASSWD_HOME` (and when `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` is unset in an unbundled source run, if `[ -n "$HOME" ]` use `$HOME` when `HOME` differs from `PASSWD_HOME` so existing `test/hook-runner.test.mjs` `HOME: HOME_DIR` / `HOME: roHome` tests continue to isolate logs in temp dirs!).
     4. Canonical `PLUGIN_DATA` resolution (exact algorithm): define helper `resolve_no_symlink_root()` that rejects non-absolute paths, walks prefix components from `/` down to target checking `[ ! -L "$_prefix" ]` on every existing component (returning non-zero on any symlink), resolves existing ancestor via `(CDPATH='' cd -- "$_existing" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)` plus non-existent trailing segments, and accepts `PLUGIN_DATA` iff that resolved path equals one of the 4 exact strings `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-ide/plugin_data/antigravity-booster`, or `${EFF_HOME}/.config/antigravity-booster` (where `EFF_HOME` is the staging-gated home from step 3); otherwise set `DATA_ROOT="${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugin_data/antigravity-booster"`.
     5. Set `umask 0077`, `HOOK_LOG_DIR="$DATA_ROOT/logs"`, `HOOK_LOG_FILE="$HOOK_LOG_DIR/hooks.log"`, `LOG_TAMPERED=0`, `LOG_DEGRADED=0`. Detect tampering (`LOG_TAMPERED=1` if `[ -L "$DATA_ROOT" ] || [ -L "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] || [ -L "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] || ( [ -e "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] && [ ! -O "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" ] ) || ( [ -e "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] && [ ! -O "$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ] )`): on `LOG_TAMPERED=1`, set `LOG_DEGRADED=1`, `HOOK_LOG_FILE="/dev/null"`, best-effort write `0600` `${EFF_HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/.agb-hook-log-degraded`, emit `stderr` warning, and in headless workers (`[ -n "$AGB_WORKER_TICKET" ] || [ -n "$AGB_WORKER_MODE" ]`) immediately emit `{"decision":"deny","reason":"agb hook audit log tampered in headless worker"}` and `exit 0`. When NOT tampered, `mkdir -p "$HOOK_LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true`, create if absent via `( set -C; : >"$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ) 2>/dev/null || true`, and test `( : >>"$HOOK_LOG_FILE" ) 2>/dev/null`: if read-only/unwritable (e.g. `bwrap` `--ro-bind` `$HOME/.gemini` in `test/hook-runner.test.mjs:689-707`), set `LOG_DEGRADED=1` (NOT `LOG_TAMPERED`), `HOOK_LOG_FILE="/dev/null"`, best-effort write `.agb-hook-log-degraded` if writable, append ` [audit-log-degraded]` on fallback JSON `reason`s in `emit_fallback`, and allow normal child execution so `test/hook-runner.test.mjs:689-707` stays 100% green!

2. Tests (`test/hook-runner.test.mjs`):
   - Add tests verifying: (a) all 4 canonical `PLUGIN_DATA` roots under `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` write `logs/hooks.log` while rogue `PLUGIN_DATA=/tmp/evil` and symlinked `PLUGIN_DATA` are rejected; (b) staging `bin/hook-runner.sh` into `<tmp>/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-booster/bin/hook-runner.sh` ignores both `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` and `HOME`; (c) symlinked `HOOK_LOG_DIR` or `HOOK_LOG_FILE` denies headless workers immediately (`decision === 'deny'`); (d) `list_dir` passes through in fallback while `manage_task` with `"Action":"kill"` denies in headless fallback.
   - Run targeted verification (`shellcheck -s sh bin/node-launcher.sh bin/hook-runner.sh && node --test test/hook-runner.test.mjs`) — do NOT waste turn budget running the full 40-file suite manually, as the scheduler gate runs `npm test` automatically after your turn!

edges.contract: t-hook-runner-passwd-home hardens bin/hook-runner.sh with PASSWD_HOME staging detection, the 4-root PLUGIN_DATA allowlist, symlink/UID tamper fail-closed denial, and fallback read-only tool updates, verified in test/hook-runner.test.mjs without touching hooks/policy/* or lib/*.

title: Enforce PASSWD_HOME audit-log anchoring and 4-root PLUGIN_DATA allowlist in hook-runner.sh
